purpose: Clinical research to improve prevention and health service planning.
question: For each Krankenhaus, how many adults have COPD on their diagnosis list? We are comparing the three record-holding hospitals rather than where people live.
definitions: Exclude patients who opted out of reuse.
Use 31 December 2025 as the reference date; age is 2025 minus birth year.
COPD means a condition ICD-10 code beginning J44.
Group by patients.data_holder, include all hospitals, and count each adult once; metric: copd_adults.
